title: The Path to Click: Are You on It?
eligible_reason: Eye-tracking lab study of visual inspection on search-engine result pages; custom likelihood model of inspection and click paths. No treatment adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: MODEL_May 2020.txt specifies the R likelihood for moment-to-moment eye movements (subscreen choice, listing choice, click-out) using gaze, scroll, recency and content-similarity covariates.
data_files_note: Moment-to-moment eye-tracking data, listing words, click-out data.
data_provenance_note: Lab eye-tracking data as used in the paper; no masking stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
